title: Set Up Your Salon to Use NEXORA TOUCH
summary: Prepare your salon details, services, staff, and payment options before welcoming customers.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

Help the owner prepare the settings staff need to book appointments, welcome customers, and take payments from the first day.

Before you start

Use an account with permission to manage salon settings. Have your contact information, opening hours, service prices, staff schedules, and payment details ready.

1. Save salon details, services, and staff

  1. Open Salon Settings and Salon Information. Save your contact information and business hours.
  2. Open Services. Add service names, prices, and durations; turn on Active.
  3. Open Staff. Enter the staff details, choose the role, pay settings, services, and work schedule, then select Save technician.

If your salon uses AI Hub, open AI Hub → Salon settings and check that Time zone matches the salon’s location. If this option is unavailable or appointment times still look incorrect, ask the owner or support to check.

2. Try booking as a customer

Open Appointments, copy the Booking online link, and open it on your phone or in a private browser window (incognito mode). Book an available service using your own contact details.

Return to Appointments and open the appointment. Check that the customer name, service, date, time, and staff member match what you selected. Check whether the appointment is pending or confirmed. Cancel the test appointment afterward to free the time slot.

See Set Up Online Booking for confirmation and notification settings.

3. Prepare checkout and receipts

  • Check the receiving account for each payment option you plan to offer. See Set Up Ways to Receive Customer Payments.
  • Confirm your tax rate, tip handling, and staff supply fees. See Set Up Tax, Tips, and Supply Fees.
  • If you print receipts, open Printer on each checkout device and select Print test receipt. You can print this sample without completing a sale.

Before your first payment

Review Take Payment and Give Customers a Receipt with the cashier. Record Cash only after receiving the money. To try checkout before serving customers, contact support for guidance. Ask which account and payment method to use. A test payment may involve real money, and completed orders still appear in reports.

If you need to check further

  • If no appointment times are available, check the salon's opening hours and the staff member's work schedule.
  • If you cannot open a setting, ask the owner to check your account permissions.

Open Front Desk and prepare the services you need

When you open Front Desk, Overview appears first. Choose a tab to manage appointments, check in customers, view tickets, or take payments. If you use SMS, a Crypto gateway, or a card terminal, complete its application and check that the service is ready: Register SMS Service and Track Your Application · Apply for a Crypto Payment Gateway or Card Terminal.

title: Update Salon Details and Opening Hours
summary: Save your address, phone number, and opening hours so customers can contact you and choose an appointment time.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

Make it easy for customers to find the salon's address, phone number, and opening hours. Staff can use the same details when answering customer questions.

Before you start

Prepare your salon name, address, phone number, email, logo, and opening hours for each day.

1. Open Salon Information

From the left menu, select POS (the point-of-sale screen), then Salon Settings and Salon Information.

2. Update your salon information

Select the edit icon, then check your salon name, address, phone number, email, and logo. Select Save when finished.

3. Update your opening hours

In Business Hours, select the edit icon. For each day of the week:

  • Turn on the days your salon is open.
  • Select the opening time.
  • Select the closing time.
  • Turn off the days your salon is closed.

Select Save.

Check your setup

  • Your salon contact information is correct.
  • Each workday shows the correct opening and closing time.
  • Closed days appear as closed.
  • When creating a test appointment, you can select a time when the salon is open and the staff member is working.

If something does not work

Business hours will not save

The closing time must be later than the opening time. Enter both times for every day the salon is open.

Appointment times look incorrect

If your salon uses AI Hub, open AI Hub → Salon settings and check that Time zone matches the salon’s location. If this option is unavailable or appointment times still look incorrect, ask the owner or support to check.

Customers cannot book a certain day

Check whether that day is closed or whether the selected time is outside business hours.

Helpful note

After changing opening hours, review any appointments already booked for those times.

title: Add Services, Prices, and Service Times
summary: List the services your salon offers, with prices and service times, for booking and checkout.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

  • Help customers see which services your salon offers and choose the one they want.
  • Give staff consistent prices and service times for booking and checkout.

Before you start

Have each service name, price, time needed, and category ready. Categories might include manicures, pedicures, or waxing.

1. Open the service list

From the left menu, select POS (the point-of-sale screen), then Salon Settings and Services.

2. Create service categories

Select Manage Categories if your salon does not have service categories yet. Add each category name, arrange the categories in the preferred order, and save.

3. Add a service

Select Add Service, then enter:

  • Service name.
  • Price.
  • Time needed for the service (duration).
  • An optional description.
  • At least one service category.

4. Make the service available

Turn on Active so the service can be used, then select Save.

Check your setup

  • The service appears in the list.
  • The price and service time are correct.
  • The service is in the correct category.
  • The service status is active.

If something does not work

The service will not save

Make sure the name, price, duration, and category have been entered.

The service does not appear during booking

Make sure the service is active and at least one technician is set up to provide it.

Before deleting a service category

Move any services you want to keep to another category first. When you delete a category, services that also belong to another category remain available. Services that belong only to the deleted category are removed from the list. If a service has appointment or order history, its past details are kept for reference.

Helpful notes

  • Start with your salon's most popular services.
  • Use short names so staff can find services quickly during checkout.
  • Allow enough time for each service so staff can be ready for the next customer.

title: Add Staff and Set Their Services and Hours
summary: Add staff, choose the services each person can provide, and save their hours so customers can book.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

  • Help customers book the right technician at a time when that person is working.
  • Help the owner see which services each person provides and when they work.

Before you start

Use an account that can manage salon settings. Prepare the staff member’s name, phone number or email, agreed pay settings, service list, and weekly work schedule.

1. Open the staff list

From the left menu, select POS (the point-of-sale screen), then Salon Settings and Staff.

2. Add a staff member

Select Add Staff to open Technician Info. Enter the technician’s name and any phone number or email available. This creates a staff profile for your salon.

3. Choose the role and pay settings

In Role, Pay & Tips:

  • POS Role: choose the role that matches the technician’s work.
  • Pay Structure: choose Commission (%), Weekly Salary ($), or Agreed Amount ($), then enter the rate or amount.
  • Tips Enabled at POS Checkout: turn on if this technician receives tips at the front-desk checkout.

4. Choose the services this person can provide

In Services, select the services the technician can provide. You can select a whole category or use Check all services if this person provides every current service.

5. Set the work schedule

In Weekly schedule, select Day off for days the technician does not work. Enter the start and end times for the remaining days.

6. Save the profile

Review the details, role, pay settings, services, and schedule, then select Save technician. These sections are saved together.

7. Edit the profile and set a clean fee if needed

Find the technician in the list and select View & Edit. You can update their details, services, and schedule in this window. If the salon charges a clean fee, enter Clean Fee ($) in Role, Pay & Tips, then select Save technician after editing.

The clean fee is deducted once for each salon-local day with ticket or service work or a pending or confirmed appointment assigned to the technician. A saved rate applies from the day it is saved; earlier days keep their previous rates. If the rate changes more than once on the same day, the latest saved amount is used for that day. Clocking in alone does not create a clean-fee charge.

Check your setup

  • The staff member appears in the staff list.
  • Their role, pay structure, tip preference, and clean fee (if used) are saved.
  • At least one service is selected for this person to provide.
  • The work schedule shows the correct days and hours.
  • You can select the staff member in a test appointment.

If something does not work

The new technician does not appear

Check that the profile was saved successfully, then search for the technician by name in the list.

The profile will not save

Check the fields showing errors: name, POS Role, pay rate or amount, and the start and end times for working days. A new technician also needs at least one selected service. Correct the fields, then select Save technician.

The staff member does not appear during booking

Make sure the staff member is active, has the service assigned, and is scheduled to work at the selected time.

Helpful note

If a staff member provides every service, select Check all services for faster setup. Review the assignment after adding new services.

title: Set Up Online Booking
summary: Choose how to receive and confirm appointments, then try booking before sharing the link with customers.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

Customers can choose their service and appointment time. Staff can check the schedule to see who is coming and what service they need.

Before you start

First, save the salon's opening hours, turn on the services you offer, choose which services each staff member can provide, and save their work schedules. Use an account that can edit salon settings.

1. Choose how to receive and confirm bookings

  1. Open Salon Information, find Booking Settings, and select the edit icon.
  2. Set Minimum notice (minutes) to choose how many minutes before an appointment customers must book. Set Maximum advance (days) to choose how many days ahead they can book.
  3. Choose Auto-confirm online bookings. When turned off, new online bookings remain pending until the salon approves them.
  4. Check the appointment reminder time and recipients under Booking SMS Notifications, then save.

2. Get the customer booking link

Open Appointments. In Booking online, select Copy. Open that link on your own phone or in a private browser window (incognito mode). Use this page to try the steps a customer will follow. + New Booking inside Appointments is the separate option for staff to enter an appointment.

3. Make and check a test appointment

  1. Check the salon name. Choose an available service, staff option, date, and time.
  2. Enter your own contact details and submit the appointment request. Check whether the request succeeded before submitting it again.
  3. Return to Appointments and select the appointment date. Open the appointment and compare the customer name, service, date, time, and staff member with your selections. With auto-confirm turned on, it should be confirmed; with auto-confirm turned off, it should be pending.
  4. Check your phone for any confirmation or reminder you enabled. Check scheduled reminders at the time set in your notification settings.
  5. Open the test appointment and select Cancel Booking when finished. Verify its canceled status.

If something is missing

  • No available times: Check salon hours, staff schedules, assigned services, service duration, and booking limits.
  • A technician is missing from the booking page: Check their profile status, assigned services, and work schedule. Ask the owner or support to check that the technician is enabled for AI Voice/SMS.
  • No booking link: Ask the owner or support to check the salon's public booking setup.
  • No SMS: Check the phone number and notification settings. Use the existing appointment when asking support to review message delivery.

Share the link with customers: After checking the appointment details and confirmation status, cancel the test appointment. You can then share the copied link so customers can book.

Related: Add Staff and Set Their Services and Hours · Create and Update Appointments

title: Set Up Ways to Receive Customer Payments
summary: Choose how customers can pay and check the receiving accounts before checkout.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

Help cashiers explain how to pay, confirm the money was received, and record the method the customer used.

Before you start

Have the owner's approved payment options and receiving account details ready. Receiving account settings and card reader activation are separate setup steps.

1. Check the accounts that receive payments

Open Accept Payment and find Receive Payment Methods. Enter account details for the supported options your salon uses, such as Zelle, Cash App, Venmo, Apple Cash, PayPal, or VLINKPAY Wallet. Save the receiving details and enable the method. For VLINKPAY Wallet, check the USDV or USDT receiving address your salon plans to use.

Save the required account details and enable each option so it can be selected at checkout. At checkout, select ··· More to see these methods. Check the account shown under Send payment to before asking a customer to pay.

2. Understand the checkout options

  • Cash: Count the money received and enter Cash received. Check the change due.
  • Card: Collect payment through the terminal or payment provider first and confirm it succeeded. Then select Card to record that the customer paid by card.
  • Direct payment apps and wallets (Zelle, Cash App, Venmo, Apple Cash, PayPal, VLINKPAY Wallet): Verify that the funds reached the salon’s receiving account. After choosing the receipt option, select Mark as received, then confirm payment to complete the order.
  • Gift Card or Crypto: Follow the instructions in the VlinkPay payment window and wait for confirmation before closing the order.
  • Split Pay: Review each payment portion and make sure their total matches the amount due. Confirm every portion before completing the order.

3. Check before collecting payment

Review the amount, payment method, and receipt option with the cashier before selecting Pay or Mark as received. For receipt testing, use Printer → Print test receipt; a completed sale is not required.

Record Cash only after receiving the money. To try checkout before serving customers, contact support for guidance. Ask which account and payment method to use, and what to do if the order needs a correction or refund. A test payment may involve real money. Labeling an order as a test does not remove it from reports.

Ready for checkout

Make sure the cashier knows which account receives the money and how to check for a successful payment on the terminal or in the payment app. If an option is unavailable, check its saved details and active status. If the customer says they have paid but the order is not marked as paid, check the receiving account or payment terminal before trying again.

Apply for optional payment services

To register a Crypto gateway or card terminal, open Settings → Service Applications. After submitting, wait for approval and service activation before using it. Saving a draft or receiving approval alone does not activate the service. See Apply for a Crypto Payment Gateway or Card Terminal.

Related: Take Payment and Give Customers a Receipt · Set Up Receipt Printing

title: Set Up Tax, Tips, and Supply Fees
summary: Check how tax and tips are calculated, and how supply fees affect staff commission.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

Help cashiers explain the customer total and help owners and technicians check tips and commission.

Before you start

Have the owner confirm the salon's tax rate with an accountant or tax professional. Agree on tip sharing, supply fees, and any technician clean fee before entering them. The tax rate below is used only to show the calculation.

1. Save the tax rate

Open Salon Information, edit the business information, enter Sales Tax Rate (%), and save. At checkout, tax is calculated on service charges after discounts plus product charges. Tips are not included in that tax calculation.

2. Check tips on each order

In Checkout Customer, open the customer's order and select the tip option. Percentage tips use the service subtotal before discounts, not the total including products and tax. If the customer wants to tip a specific amount, enter it. Check how much each technician will receive before saving.

3. Check supply fees used to calculate commission

Review Supply Fee for each service in Services. This fee is deducted from the service amount before staff commission is calculated. It is not an extra charge to the customer. Check the agreed pay settings in Staff → Role, Pay & Tips.

4. Set a clean fee for technicians

If the salon charges a clean fee, open Staff, select View & Edit, and enter Clean Fee ($) in Role, Pay & Tips. Select Save technician after editing.

The fee is deducted once for each salon-local day with ticket or service work or a pending or confirmed appointment assigned to the technician. A new rate applies from the day it is saved; earlier days keep their previous rates, and days before the first rate was set are not charged. If the rate changes on the same day, the latest saved amount is used for that day. Clocking in alone does not create a clean-fee charge.

The clean fee is deducted from the technician’s earnings in their report. It is not an extra charge to the customer.

Processing fees are charged by the company that handles your payments. Review them separately from amounts charged to customers and supply fees used to calculate commission. In Store Income, Merchant Fee shows Stripe fees recorded by the system for successful card transactions on completed orders. Track fees from other payment providers separately if used.

Example: check the amount due

  • Services: $100, less a $10 discount = $90.
  • Amount used to calculate tax: $90.
  • Example tax rate of 5%: $4.50.
  • A dollar tip entered as $15.
  • Customer total: $90 + $4.50 + $15 = $109.50.

For this same order, a 20% service tip is calculated on the $100 service subtotal, giving a $20 tip. Review the displayed amount before continuing.

Check before collecting payment

The order should show the intended discounts, tax, tip, and total. If it differs from your calculation, check the saved tax rate, service and product amounts, discount amounts, and whether the tip is a percentage or a dollar amount. Check and correct any amount that is wrong before selecting Pay.

Related: Take Payment and Give Customers a Receipt · Review Each Technician’s Work and Earnings

title: Set Up Receipt Printing
summary: Choose a print method, save receipt settings, and print a sample before using it at checkout.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

Give customers a clear, readable receipt after checkout.

Before you start

Set up printing on every computer or tablet that will print receipts. Have paper and a printer that supports your chosen print method ready. Set up card readers separately.

1. Choose a print method

Open POS → Printer on the checkout device and choose the method that matches your equipment.

Star receipt printer

  1. Select Star receipt printer. Use Install to get Star PassPRNT if it is not installed.
  2. Open Star PassPRNT and select a compatible Star printer using the connection supported by that printer, such as Bluetooth or your network.
  3. Return to Printer setup and choose the paper width that matches the loaded roll: 58 mm or 80 mm.

AirPrint or computer printer

  1. Select AirPrint / Computer printer.
  2. On an iPad, connect to the same network as the compatible AirPrint printer. On a computer, first make sure the printer works from the computer's print window.
  3. When the print window opens, select the correct printer and paper size. This method does not need Star PassPRNT.

Other printer or not sure which type you have

Open Other printer / Not sure for guidance. On iPad, check that the printer supports AirPrint and connect both devices to the same network. On a computer, install the manufacturer’s driver and add the printer to your system, then choose AirPrint / Computer printer. If the printer does not support AirPrint and you want to use it with iPad, send its brand, model, connection type, and your browser details to Nexora support for help.

2. Save copy counts and print a sample

In Receipt settings, set Card payment copies and Other payment copies separately, then select Save settings. These counts apply when you choose a printed receipt at checkout. Each allows 0 to 3 copies. Choose 0 to turn off automatic printing for that group of payment methods.

Select Print test receipt. If a print window opens, choose the printer and select Print. This sends one sample to check the connection and paper size; the saved copy counts do not apply to test prints. A sale is not required.

Check the physical receipt: text is readable, totals are fully visible, and the content fits the paper. If nothing prints, check printer power, paper, the selected connection, and any waiting print window before trying again.

Related: Take Payment and Give Customers a Receipt

title: Set Up a Customer Check-In Tablet
summary: Open the check-in link on a shared tablet or pair the tablet with a name and access PIN.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

Customers can use a shared tablet at the front desk to check in. Your salon can open the kiosk link on the tablet or pair it with a device name and access PIN.

Before you start

Have a tablet with an internet connection ready and use an account with permission to manage check-in devices. Choose how you want to set up the tablet: the kiosk link does not need pairing or a PIN; pairing registers the tablet with the salon using a device name and PIN. Follow the steps for the option your salon uses.

1. Open check-in on a shared tablet

  1. Open Self Check-in Device and find the kiosk check-in link.
  2. Copy the link and open it in the browser on the shared tablet. This option does not use a pairing QR code or an access PIN.
  3. Make sure the salon's public page and Public Check-in are enabled. If either is unavailable, follow the message on the screen.
  4. Confirm the salon name and that the customer check-in screen opens. After a successful check-in, the kiosk returns to its start screen automatically after 8 seconds.

Customers can check in for an appointment on this tablet at the same times allowed on the public check-in page. If check-in is not available yet, follow the message or ask the front desk to check the appointment. To register the tablet with a device name and PIN, use the pairing steps below.

2. Pair a check-in tablet with a PIN, if used

  1. Open Self Check-in Device using an authorized account.
  2. Use the tablet to scan the pairing QR code and connect it to the salon.
  3. On Pair this tablet, enter a device name, a 4–6 digit access PIN, and the PIN confirmation. Select Pair tablet.
  4. Verify that the device appears as active and the tablet opens the customer check-in screen.

The pairing code is single-use and expires after 15 minutes. If it expires or was already used, generate a new code. Share the PIN only with staff who are allowed to manage the tablet.

Related: Let Customers Check In with a QR Code

title: Review Each Step from Arrival to Checkout
summary: Review booking, arrival, services, and payment with staff before they start using NEXORA TOUCH.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

Help front-desk staff, technicians, and cashiers know what to do at each step, from booking to the receipt.

Check before welcoming customers

To get familiar with serving a customer: review settings, open the customer booking link, and print a sample receipt if you use a printer. You do not need to complete a test payment on the salon's regular account.

To try checkout before serving customers: contact support for guidance. Ask which account and payment method to use, whether corrections or refunds are available, and what to do with test appointments and orders afterward. A test payment may involve real money. Completed orders still appear in reports, even when labeled as tests.

1. Review the steps and print a sample receipt

  1. Follow Set Up Online Booking to check the customer-facing link. If you make a test appointment, use your own contact details, verify it in Appointments, and cancel it afterward.
  2. Read Check In Customers With or Without Appointments, Track Waiting Customers and Service Progress, and Take Payment and Give Customers a Receipt with the team. Review each step while keeping real customer tickets unchanged.
  3. Open Printer and select Print test receipt if the salon uses printed receipts. Check the paper output; no sale is required.
  4. Confirm receiving accounts and review Set Up Tax, Tips, and Supply Fees. For this check, review the details without selecting Pay.

2. Practice with instructions from support

Before trying these steps, ask support which NEXORA TOUCH accounts the front desk and technician should use and which payment method is approved for the exercise. Once support has confirmed this, each person signs in with the specified account and follows the steps below:

  1. Make a test appointment using the contact details agreed with support.
  2. Check in the appointment and find the customer's ticket in the waiting list.
  3. The front desk assigns and confirms the technician on the POS ticket. The technician opens the ticket in their Work Order and uses the action at the bottom of the screen to start and complete their assigned work. See Start and Complete Services on a Work Order. The front desk checks the progress before checkout.
  4. Review the total, tip, receipt choice, and approved payment instructions before completing checkout.
  5. Check the completed order and receipt, then follow support's instructions for the test appointments and orders.

When you need help

If you encounter an error, take a screenshot of the message and note the appointment or order number. Check whether the previous action succeeded before retrying. If you are unsure whether money was received, ask the owner or support to check the payment record before collecting it again.

After checking: Staff should know how to find an appointment, check in a customer, assign a technician, track services, and complete checkout. For any step that is still unclear, open the relevant guide above or contact support.

Check the options your salon uses

  • Check that you can enter a phone number, correct it, adjust service quantities, and choose a technician who can provide the selected services. See Check In Customers With or Without Appointments.
  • If you use a shared check-in tablet, check the kiosk link or paired device. If you print a poster, scan its QR code. See Set Up a Customer Check-In Tablet · Let Customers Check In with a QR Code.
  • If technicians add photos when finishing services, check that the front desk can view the saved photos. See Start and Complete Services on a Work Order.
  • If the salon uses Gift Card or Crypto Card, check the last 4 digits of the card, amount paid, remaining balance, and currency on a receipt from a completed payment. You do not need to make another payment for this check.

title: Checklist Before Using NEXORA TOUCH
summary: Check the settings and service steps with staff before serving your first customer through NEXORA TOUCH.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

Help the owner and staff check what needs to be in place before accepting appointments and serving customers.

Salon details and booking

  • Update Salon Details and Opening Hours: contact details (address, phone number, and email) and opening hours are correct. If the salon uses AI Hub, Time zone has been checked in AI Hub → Salon settings. If that option is unavailable, the owner or support has checked it.
  • Add Services, Prices, and Service Times: prices, service times, and categories have been checked, and the services you offer are active.
  • Add Staff and Set Their Services and Hours: roles, pay settings, service assignments, and schedules are saved.
  • Set Up Online Booking: a test appointment made through the customer link shows the selected name, service, date, time, and staff member. Its pending or confirmed status matches your auto-confirm setting. The test appointment has been canceled after checking.

Checkout and equipment

  • Set Up Ways to Receive Customer Payments: receiving accounts are correct and the cashier knows how to verify receipt of funds.
  • Set Up Tax, Tips, and Supply Fees: the owner has checked the settings. Staff know which amounts the customer pays and which are used to calculate commission.
  • Set Up Receipt Printing: if paper receipts are used, Print test receipt produces a clear sample from each checkout device that will print.
  • Let Customers Check In with a QR Code: check the option your salon uses. For phone check-in, scan the public QR code and confirm it opens the salon's customer page. For a shared tablet, follow Set Up a Customer Check-In Tablet and confirm the check-in screen opens on that tablet. If you offer both, check both.

Staff readiness

  • The team has reviewed Check In Customers With or Without Appointments, Track Waiting Customers and Service Progress, and Take Payment and Give Customers a Receipt.
  • Cashiers know how to check money received for each payment method and whom to contact when a payment is unclear.
  • The owner has checked that each staff member can open the screens needed for their work.

A test payment is not required

You can review checkout and print a sample receipt without collecting money on the salon's regular account. Completed orders still appear in reports, even when labeled as tests.

To try checkout before serving customers, read Review Each Step from Arrival to Checkout and contact support for guidance on which account and payment method to use.

Before welcoming customers: Review each item above with the staff member responsible. Check printers and self check-in options only if your salon uses them.

Check devices and registered services

  • Check the customer check-in methods your salon offers. For a kiosk, make sure the public page and Public Check-in are enabled and the tablet opens the right link. For a paired tablet, check its connection and access PIN. For phone check-in, scan the customer QR code.
  • If the salon uses its own SMS sender, check that registration is approved. See Register SMS Service and Track Your Application.
  • If the salon uses a Crypto gateway or card terminal, check that the service is active before taking payments. A submitted or approved application alone is not enough. See Apply for a Crypto Payment Gateway or Card Terminal.

title: Register SMS Service and Track Your Application
summary: Fill out your SMS application, submit it, and check the review result.
htmlContent:
Benefits for your salon

SMS registration lets your salon set up its own sender for customer messages. You can follow the application and see when you need to provide more information or verify a phone number.

Before you start

Sign in with the salon owner’s account. Make sure the AI Voice plan and assigned phone number are active. Have the business details, address, representative details, and sample messages ready.

1. Open SMS registration

Open Settings → Service Applications and select SMS registration. If registration is not available, follow the message to activate AI Voice or set up its phone number first.

2. Prepare and submit the application

  1. Choose the business registration type that applies to your salon from the available options. Check the business and representative details against your records.
  2. Describe the messages you plan to send, add sample messages, and explain how customers agree to receive them. Follow the instructions and text limits shown for each item.
  3. If you need to finish later, select Save draft. Submit the draft when it is ready for review.
  4. Complete the required items, select Submit for Nexora review, and check the status. You cannot edit the application while it is under review.

3. Follow verification and review

  • Changes requested: Read Nexora’s note, update the requested information, and submit again.
  • Verification needed: If your Sole Proprietor application requires it, use the owner’s real U.S. or Canadian mobile number, as requested on the form. Use the owner’s mobile number rather than the AI Voice number. Follow the verification text before the deadline shown. Select Resend verification text when available if you need another text.
  • Brand or campaign review: Check the progress and wait for the approval result.
  • Approved: Read the confirmation that your salon can use its registered sender.
  • Rejected, expired, suspended, or deactivated: Read the message and contact Nexora with your application details for help.

Check the result

After submitting, check that the status has changed. Complete any requested corrections or verification, then keep checking until the application is approved.

Prepare credit for sending messages

SMS registration sets up your sender. SMS Credits pay for sending messages, while Ads Credit pays for advertising. You still need registration approval even if you have added credit. See Set Up AI Voice and Send Customer Text Messages to prepare and check your messages.

Related: Set Up AI Voice and Send Customer Text Messages · Add Ads Credit and Review Activity
